# Pull Request

## Description

Brief description of what this PR does:

## Type of change

Please delete options that are not relevant:

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Tests only
- [ ] Refactoring (no functional changes)

## Testing

Please describe the tests that you ran to verify your changes:

- [ ] Unit tests pass
- [ ] Integration tests pass
- [ ] Added new tests for new functionality
- [ ] Manual testing performed

**Test Configuration**:
- OS: [e.g., Ubuntu 20.04, macOS 13.0, Windows 11]
- Python version: [e.g., 3.8, 3.9, 3.10, 3.11]
- CUDA version (if applicable): [e.g., 11.8, 12.1]
- GPU (if applicable): [e.g., RTX 3080, V100]

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published in downstream modules
- [ ] I have checked my code and corrected any misspellings
- [ ] I have updated the version number (if applicable)
- [ ] I have updated the CHANGELOG.md (if applicable)

## Review Process

**Automated Checks**:
- [ ] Quick PR check passes
- [ ] Full CI pipeline passes

**Manual Review**:
- [ ] Code review by maintainer
- [ ] Documentation review (if applicable)
- [ ] Performance impact assessed (if applicable)

## Additional Context

Add any other context about the problem here, including:
- Related issues or pull requests
- Screenshots (if applicable)
- Performance benchmarks (if applicable)
- Migration guide (for breaking changes)
